interpretation.strong_evidence: The 10 chickens are active runtime chicken entities and exactly match the official Deathmatch minimum desired chicken count of 10.
interpretation.hammer_id_note: Hammer ID null is consistent with runtime-spawned entities and supports, but by itself does not prove, that these are not ten hand-authored Train map entities.
interpretation.sequential_entindex_note: The contiguous entindex range 172-181 is consistent with a batch/runtime creation event at mode startup.
interpretation.henrietta_status: NOT_IDENTIFIED; all visible entities are generic classname chicken with no Henrietta targetname.
